identification.name: E-Glass / Epoxy (Woven, NEMA G-10)
identification.common_form_notes: Available as FR-4 / NEMA G-10 laminate sheet from electrical/insulation suppliers. Machines well with carbide tooling; avoid excessive heat during cutting to prevent delamination.
identification.notes: Woven E-glass fabric / epoxy laminate per NEMA Grade G-10 standard. Properties are for the in-plane (warp/fill) directions; a balanced weave makes properties approximately equal in both directions. Through-thickness tensile strength and interlaminar shear strength are much lower than in-plane values (typically 30–50 MPa) — design against delamination in peel or through-thickness loading. Shear strength is the in-plane measured value from NEMA G-10 data; von Mises derivation does not apply to composite materials. The epoxy matrix is a thermoset: no melting point; maximum service temperature is controlled by the matrix Tg (~130 °C for standard FR-4 resin). Not suitable for sustained loads at elevated temperature without specific creep data. Ductility values represent strain to fracture (brittle failure); there is no plastic yield.

typical_usage: Electrical insulation panels and PCB substrates (FR-4), structural laminates in moisture-sensitive environments, jigs and fixtures, tooling plates, machine guards, and general-purpose composite sheet where moderate stiffness, electrical insulation, and low cost are required.
